---
title: "2 · From ranks to grades"
---

An ordered grade report states directions between grades and withholds comparisons within grades. The [two-unit example](one-pair.qmd) compares the costs of each action for one pair. The [report builder](report-builder.qmd) then shows which combinations of decisions a complete grade report can make. We use [posterior risk](price-of-silence.qmd) to compare those reports and examine how the best report changes with the [cost of withholding](frontier.qmd) or the [set of eligible reports](families.qmd). Part 3 applies the same measures to [common reporting rules](../rules/index.qmd).
